exposure: Caesarean section wound infection after delivery
Symptoms present 14 days prior to study exit
cohort: 1476 randomly selected pregnant women in Ghana
finding: The study found a low incidence of maternal sepsis in Ghana; however, urinary tract infections, caesarean section wound infections, and presence of symptoms 14 days prior to study exit were significant risk factors.
gest_age: Majority entered the study at 10-13 weeks of gestation
